'''Mike Wood''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Wizard World King of Corellia]] on 18 August 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit mains]], according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2867">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-hehd2867/ geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-heh], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-hehd2867/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
